evidence.title: PoPLi detected an instructed wording code with incomplete false-alarm validation
evidence.observation: Denamganaï reports a replay-based comparison of partner and outsider action responses to meaning-preserving paraphrases. An instructed wording code produced a gap in simulated markets, while the no-code gap was near zero.
evidence.evidence_standing: Source-reported bounded observation; not independently verified
evidence.glossary_fit: Commons interpretation only; founding definitions and standings unchanged

source_locations.SRC-157: Linked report main.v3, Abstract; Sections 4–5.1; Appendix A

evidence.limitations: One model, one environment, ten markets per condition, a scripted speaker and an instructed code. Neither listener acted on honest remarks, leaving false-alarm validity incomplete. Meaning-carried codes are outside the test. This is not demonstrated detection of learned or emergent collusion.
evidence.open_questions: Do the findings generalize beyond the reported setting? Underlying results and mechanisms are not independently reproduced.
evidence.support_assessment: Attributed finding with bounded descriptive mappings; no general prevalence or independent corroboration asserted.
evidence.dispute_status: Source access, version and generalization qualifications retained; no systematic clearance.

terms.name: Investigative indicator

terms.name: Observability boundary
